name: STA414H1 — Correction Attribution (Graphical Models)

steps.template_en: 'Directed edges mean causation.' NOT necessarily! Bayesian networks encode CONDITIONAL INDEPENDENCE, not causation. A directed edge might represent a causal relationship, but it could also be a convenient factorization.
steps.template_zh: '有向边意味因果。'不一定！贝叶斯网编码条件独立，不是因果。有向边可能表示因果关系，也可能是方便的因子分解。

steps.template_en: Directed Graphical Model (Bayesian Net): nodes=variables, edges=dependencies. Factorization: P(X₁,...,Xₙ)=∏P(Xᵢ|Pa(Xᵢ)). DAG required (no cycles). Chain: X→Y→Z ⟺ X ⟂ Z | Y.
steps.template_zh: 有向图模型(贝叶斯网)：P(X₁,...,Xₙ)=∏P(Xᵢ|Pa(Xᵢ))。需DAG(无环)。链：X→Y→Z⟺X⟂Z|Y。

steps.template_en: Undirected (Markov Random Field): factorization over cliques. P(X)∝∏_{cliques} ψ_C(X_C). Potentials ψ_C are non-negative, NOT probabilities (must normalize). Used for: image segmentation (pixel CRF), spatial statistics.
steps.template_zh: 无向图(Markov随机场)：在团上分解。势函数ψ_C非负不是概率(需归一化)。用于：图像分割、空间统计。

steps.template_en: Conditional Random Field (CRF): P(Y|X)∝exp(Σλₖfₖ(Y_c,X)). Discriminative! Rather than modeling P(X,Y), model P(Y|X) directly. Better when X has complex dependencies we don't want to model.
steps.template_zh: 条件随机场(CRF)：P(Y|X)∝exp(Σλₖfₖ(Y_c,X))。判别式！直接建模P(Y|X)。当X有复杂依赖时更好。

steps.template_en: (1) Draw a Bayesian net for: Cloudy → Rain, Cloudy → Sprinkler. Rain → Wet Grass, Sprinkler → Wet Grass. (2) Is Rain ⟂ Sprinkler? (3) Condition on Wet Grass — are they independent? (4) What if we also condition on Cloudy?
steps.template_zh: (1)画贝叶斯网。(2)Rain和Sprinkler独立吗？(3)给定Wet Grass后独立吗？(4)再给定Cloudy呢？

steps.template_en: Graphical models = VISUAL language for probability. Structure LEARNING (finding the graph from data) is NP-hard. BUT given a graph, inference (computing probabilities) uses message passing (belief propagation). The junction tree algorithm generalizes this.
steps.template_zh: 图模型=概率的可视化语言。结构学习(NP难)。给定图，推断用消息传递(信念传播)。联结树算法推广了这一点。
